nextReadySlice.title: Manifest follow-on prioritization
failingProof: A reviewed next slice must narrow whether the manifest workstream should widen runtime or CLI inspection projections first, or instead align manifest artifacts with migration, OpenAPI, and performance outputs before another implementation session starts.
If that prioritization is skipped, the next orchestrator session cannot produce a dependency-safe failing proof from the remaining broad manifest checklist items without guessing at scope.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Choose and record the next narrow manifest follow-on before implementation. The remaining work is broader than one dependency-safe slice until a human reviewer prioritizes between wider runtime/CLI inspection projections and cross-artifact manifest alignment.

current.openReviewGate: Choose and record the next narrow manifest follow-on before implementation. The remaining manifest work branches between wider runtime/CLI inspection projections and cross-artifact manifest alignment.
